productFantasy: You are a street skater in a dusk-lit industrial plaza, chaining ollies, grinds and manuals into ever-longer combos while a two-minute clock burns; every landed line feels loud, fast and earned, and bailing costs you everything you stacked.

productShell.persistenceContract: High-score table (top 10 with name, score, combo), selected skater, and settings (music/sfx volume, camera nudge invert) persist to user://grindline_save.json. A corrupt or unreadable file is quarantined to user://grindline_save.corrupt and a fresh default save is created; no run blocks on I/O.
productShell.loadingFallback: Boot shows the GRINDLINE title card with an animated progress bar fed by real import steps; any asset that fails to load within 10s drops to its manifest fallback and the bar continues. No network reads at boot.
productShell.missingMediaFallback: A missing model swaps to a flat-shaded gray hull of matching bounds, a missing texture to flat palette gray, a missing sound to silence; gameplay never halts and the HUD flags degraded mode with a small wrench icon.

assetIo.backoffPolicy: Exponential: retry after 250ms then 500ms, then fall back per manifest entry; all loads are local res:// reads

actionBeats.stateResult: Grounded-to-air transition: vertical velocity set to 7.2 m/s, trick window opens, board snaps under feet; measurable as y-velocity flip and state change within one physics tick
Airborne-to-grind latch: board locks to rail line, velocity redirects along rail axis, balance meter appears and decays; measurable as grind state + lateral offset bounded within 0.15 m
Combo lost: ragdoll tumble plays, multiplier resets to 1, camera shake trauma 0.6, control locked 900ms then reset at last safe spot

debugBridge.transport: Headless Godot sim scene (sim/sim_bridge.tscn) driven by CLI: godot --headless --path . sim/sim_bridge.tscn -- --script-json commands.json; deterministic seed via reset(seed); JSON status lines on stdout, PNG screenshots written to shots/, exit code carries pass/fail

proofBoundary.buildGate: godot --headless --path . --import must parse every scene/script with zero errors before any story verify runs
proofBoundary.runtimeGate: Behavioral claims require the sim bridge running the real game headless with measured stdout metrics and screenshots; grep alone never proves behavior
proofBoundary.targetDevice: macOS desktop on Apple Silicon (Mac Studio primary), keyboard-first with full gamepad support; touch portrait verified via viewport emulation only
